configurations._comment: Windows (Yogesh). JSON has no raw backslashes in strings — every one in a path must be doubled, or the whole file fails to parse and NONE of these servers can be started.
configurations.name: frontend

configurations._comment: macOS. The fixture API (scripts/fixture-server.mjs) — no database, no backend. Start it before mac-frontend to see the app with data in it.
configurations.name: mac-fixture-api

configurations._comment: macOS. The REAL backend against whatever DB_NAME in backend/.env points at (a throwaway database, not founder-os-58). Messaging keys are blanked on the command line so no test can text a real person — backend/.env has a live APM_SMS_API_KEY in it.
configurations.name: mac-backend
runtimeArgs: cd backend && APM_SMS_API_KEY= APM_OTP_ENDPOINT= TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID= TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN= TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER= WHATSAPP_API_KEY= WA_TENANT_ID= DEV_OTP_IN_RESPONSE=1 .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn server:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
